title: Zabbix: Add support for agent redirection message
description:
This is a Zabbix 7.0 enhancement: proxy load balancing, where the proxy can redirect an active agent to another proxy in the proxy group.

The redirect message is currently undocumented (but 7.0 has not been released yet, it is currently in 7.0.0rc2). Sample capture: [zabbix70-agent-redirection-sample.pcapng](/uploads/4cebe071197fdeffa51381647e6ac98b/zabbix70-agent-redirection-sample.pcapng)

notes.body:
It probably doesn't make sense to copy the hostname and add it every time a PDU is dissected, and on multiple types of PDUs. It doesn't leak memory exactly, but it does make unnecessary copies.

You probably only want to do this on the first pass, and only if it hasn't been set already. (If it's been set already but it's different on the same conversation, perhaps an expert info warning.)

Oh, you are right, I haven't really thought about the multiple passes there. I'll do something about it.

A question though: Is it possible to detect the first vs. subsequent passes somehow, string/json handling optimization in mind?
Yes, or the `PINFO_FD_VISITED(pinfo)` macro equivalent. Those are false on the first pass, true afterwards.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15751/diffs?diff_id=1018934960&start_sha=254abea497b6233da31886cb4b95e2cd15a26ada#54d1d552eae5dbb6b209c2ddb988d480efacf051_443_449)
